title: Job Interview Tips: The Question That Gets You  Hired
description:
Most job interviews don’t fail because candidates aren’t qualified — they fail because the interviewer never clearly sees how the candidate fits the role.

In this video, I share one powerful job interview strategy: the interview question that helps hiring managers picture you in the role. This single question can turn an interview from basic Q&A into a real conversation — and help you stand out from equally qualified candidates.

This interview tip is especially helpful if you:

Interview well, but don’t get offers

Feel confident but still get passed over

Want to stand out without sounding rehearsed

 Want more strategic interview questions?

Watch my long-form interview video on questions to ask the interviewer (linked in the pinned comment).

 Visit kirchnercareers.com for job search and interview resources.

transcript: Can I blow your mind for a minute? The best candidate does not get the job. It is the candidate that checks most of the boxes and makes the strongest connection to the interviewer. One way to do that is to ensure that you leave the interviewer picturing you actually in the role. And here's how you accomplish that. One, you want to make sure you reflect back a problem or a painoint you heard them mention during the interview. For example, I hear you say that onboarding remote employees has been a challenge. Then connect it back to a past success or achievement. In my last role, I reduced onboarding time by 45% through process and workflow optimization. Then ask something like, is this how you see me adding value to the role? Or is this how you see me working with your team? What you have just done there is you have given them the opportunity to hear themselves talking about you as the candidate. And that is super powerful because they have already visualized you doing a role, setting you up as their top candidate. Follow me at Krishna Careers for one of a kind career tips.
